description: This file defines a frontend UI component 'NotesHome' for a notes application using LightningJS. It includes component setup, template layout, state management, hooks for lifecycle, methods for interaction, and keyboard input handling.

classes.name: NotesHome
classes.description: Main UI component for the notes application, managing layout, note selection, editing, and user interactions within LightningJS framework.

methods.name: $onSearch
methods.description: Handles search input, updates query in notesStore and triggers detail rendering.

methods.name: $onSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of a note, updates the notesStore with selected note id and renders detail.

methods.name: $onAdd
methods.description: Creates a new note and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: _onSave
methods.description: Saves the current note content through notesStore and updates the display.

methods.name: _onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note via notesStore and refreshes the UI.

methods.name: _renderDetail
methods.description: Renders the note detail view or placeholder text based on current selection.
